package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/form"
)

func token(prefix, letter string) string { return prefix + strings.Repeat(letter, 128) }

func field(id, label, value, message string, invalid bool) string {
	control := form.RenderInput(form.Input{
		ID: id, Name: id, Value: value, Invalid: invalid, HasHelp: !invalid,
	})
	f := form.Field{Label: label, For: id, Control: template.HTML(control)}
	if invalid {
		f.Error = message
	} else {
		f.Help = message
	}
	return form.RenderField(f)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 || (os.Args[1] != "light" && os.Args[1] != "dark") {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: settings-control-reflow light|dark")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	theme := os.Args[1]
	helpField := field("field-help-control", token("FIELD_LABEL_", "L"), "Help value", token("FIELD_HELP_", "H"), false)
	errorField := field("field-error-control", "Error field", "Error value", token("FIELD_ERROR_", "E"), true)
	checkbox := form.RenderCheckbox(form.Checkbox{
		ID: "long-checkbox", Name: "long_checkbox", Label: token("CHECKBOX_LABEL_", "C"),
	})
	radios := form.RenderRadioGroup(form.RadioGroup{
		Name: "long_radio", Legend: token("RADIO_LEGEND_", "G"), Value: "first",
		Options: []form.Option{
			{Value: "first", Label: token("RADIO_OPTION_ONE_", "O")},
			{Value: "second", Label: token("RADIO_OPTION_TWO_", "P")},
		},
		Help: token("RADIO_HELP_", "R"),
	})
	normal := field("normal-control", "Display name", "Normal Value", "Shown to collaborators.", false)
	sections, err := form.RenderSettingsSections([]form.SettingsSection{
		{HeadingID: "field-help", Title: "Field label and help", Description: "Public Field strings.", Content: template.HTML(`<div data-case="field-help">` + helpField + `</div>`)},
		{HeadingID: "field-error", Title: "Field error", Description: "Public validation copy.", Content: template.HTML(`<div data-case="field-error">` + errorField + `</div>`)},
		{HeadingID: "checkbox", Title: "Checkbox label", Description: "A native boolean control.", Content: template.HTML(`<div data-case="checkbox">` + checkbox + `</div>`)},
		{HeadingID: "radio", Title: "Radio labels", Description: "A native exclusive choice.", Content: template.HTML(`<div data-case="radio">` + radios + `</div>`)},
		{HeadingID: "normal", Title: "Normal control", Description: "Short-label geometry control.", Content: template.HTML(`<div data-case="normal">` + normal + `</div>`)},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf(`<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Settings control reflow</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface text-ink p-4"><main class="mx-auto max-w-4xl"><h1 class="mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold">Settings control reflow</h1><h2 class="text-xl font-semibold">Profile controls</h2><form method="post" action="/not-implemented">%s</form></main></body></html>`, theme, sections)
}
